notes: Company: John Lewis Home (johnlewis.com), UK. Access: direct HTTP via curl_cffi impersonate=chrome131, no WAF block. This is genuine site-exposed sub-structure, not an invented split, and per the brief's overlap rule ('the same products may legitimately sit in their normal category - a separate project - and here in New Arrivals; that is not an error') all six are kept even though Furniture/Bedding/Cushions sit outside the narrower Home-Decor-only category project's historical scope: this cross-cutting New Arrivals project spans the union of that scope (Furniture.xlsx, Textile.xlsx, and the original Home Decor categories), i.e. John Lewis's whole Home & Garden + Furniture & Lighting business. 'New In Lighting' (site heading) is served at the 'new-season-lighting' URL and is also the same node reachable from the dedicated Lighting department page's own 'Inspire me' section, confirming it as the Lighting hub's genuine new-arrivals listing, not a themed seasonal campaign (real product grid, 140 results, standard PLP facets/sort). No separate/standalone 'What's New' or 'Just In' page exists outside this Home-new-in structure. Also checked: Home & Garden department mega-menu, category.xml sitemap, and confirmed each candidate is a real PLP (browsable grid + count + facets + sort), not a lookbook/marketing page, via each page's own __NEXT_DATA__ productListingData payload.
